verdict.rationale: Gram documents a CLI (gram-docs-21/30) and a first-party 'Platform MCP' server (gram-docs-7/22) that let admins authenticate, deploy sources, and manage servers/skills/policies programmatically — effectively an agentic control surface. However, an active probe found no public REST/OpenAPI API (all openapi.json/swagger.json paths 404'd, gram-probe-3), so there's no conventional documented public API beyond the CLI/MCP surface. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI public API, independent confirmation of API completeness beyond CLI/MCP.
